question: Which of the following nations ‘unintentionally’ shot down a Ukrainian Boeing 737-800 passenger aircraft in January 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iran admits to ‘unintentionally’ shot down a Ukrainian Boeing 737-800 passenger aircraft in January 2020, the result of human error.**

 
 
• The Iranian government later declared that the shooting-down was a “disastrous mistake” by forces who were on high alert during a regional confrontation with the United States.
 
• The Boeing 737-800 airliner, flight PS752, crashed five minutes after takeoff from Tehran’s Imam Khomeini airport on Wednesday, Jan. 8.
 
 
• just hours after Iran fired a barrage of missiles at U.S. targets in Iraq.
 
 
 
• Iran’s President Hassan Rouhani took to Twitter to call the crash a “great tragedy” and an “unforgivable mistake.”
 
• Iranian Foreign Minister Javad Zarif blamed America’s actions for the “human error".
 
• The Iranian statement stressed that the “human error” occurred during very high tensions with the U.S.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Ukraine** :

 
 
• Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe.
 
• It is the second-largest country in Europe after Russia, which borders to the east and north-east country located in eastern Europe.
 
• The nation's capital and largest city are Kyiv.
 
• **Volodymyr Zelensky is the current president of Ukraine.**
 
 
 
• **Iran :**
 
 
• Tehran is the capital of Iran.
 
• Iran is also called Persia and officially the Islamic Republic of Iran.
 
• It is the second-largest country in the Middle East (after Saudi Arabia), the sixth-largest entirely in Asia, and its capital and largest city are Tehran.
 
• **Ebrahim Raisi is the current president of Iran.**
